clue.text: African missionary for whom faith was the vital rock

parts.note: vital in the sense of alive, full of life
a stone is a piece of rock

explanation.surface: A tribute to a missionary whose religious belief was the bedrock of his life.
explanation.walkthrough: David Livingstone was the Scottish missionary and explorer of Africa; 'African missionary' means a missionary in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Victorian explorer and preacher spent his career evangelising across central Africa.

clue.text: The rest, having told fibs, admit it

parts.note: to tell fibs is to lie, so having done so is lied
to own up is to admit

explanation.surface: Someone who has been lying should now confess the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: A short nap or period of repose on a bed or sofa is a rest.

clue.text: Replacement of VAT is in prospect

indicators.note: replacing the letters means putting them back in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A forecast that value added tax may be swapped for another levy.
explanation.walkthrough: VAT is value added tax, the British sales tax; its letters plus IS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a wide view, the same as a scenic outlook.

clue.text: This fruit makes a heavenly drink in the East

parts.note: nectar was the drink of the gods in Greek myth
taken as written
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A fruit said to produce a divine beverage in Oriental lands.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned peach variety is a kind of stone fruit.

clue.text: False direction given to radio enthusiast

parts.note: S is south, a compass direction
a ham is an amateur radio operator

explanation.surface: Wrong instructions handed to an amateur broadcaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Something counterfeit or pretended is fake, just like a false thing.

clue.text: Categorical battle-cry of the Socialist

definitions.meaning: a left-winger's slogan would demand that the right wing be thrown out

explanation.definitionFit: Absolute and unqualified, and also read as a call to expel the political right.

clue.text: The set in charge of moral values

indicators.note: set in the sense of arranged or rearranged, signalling a new order for the letters

explanation.surface: The ruling group responsible for a code of conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: A system of moral principles is a code of right conduct.

clue.text: In favour of a number consuming form of nourishment

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: consuming means eating up, so one piece is taken inside the other

parts.note: ten is a number
a as in one, written I as a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Supporting some figure who is eating a type of food.
explanation.definitionFit: A nutrient found in meat, eggs and beans is an essential element of diet.

clue.text: Trips over the coal-scuttle — that's careless

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece is placed above the second

parts.note: trips and slips are both stumbles
a hod is a scuttle for carrying coal

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles over the coal bucket through lack of care.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapdash, sloppy work is done without care.

clue.text: Where Great Yarmouth is teas cost a bomb

indicators.note: a bomb explodes the letters, sending them into a new order

explanation.surface: In a Norfolk seaside resort, afternoon tea is very expensive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cost a bomb' is British slang for being very expensive; Great Yarmouth is a seaside town in Norfolk on England's eastern shore.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norfolk resort lies on England's North Sea seaboard.

clue.text: He will love to get a greeting

parts.note: taken as written
'll is the contracted form of will
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A man will be happy to receive a salutation.
explanation.definitionFit: The everyday word said on meeting someone is a salutation.

clue.text: Even in Arizona parsley is grown

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Parsley is grown in the state of Arizona just as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Being level or equal with something is to be even with it.

clue.text: Discipline lacking in one of the followers

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the letters of the next word are removed

explanation.surface: One of the faithful is said to show no self-control.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of the twelve apostles was a follower of Jesus.

clue.text: Have forty winks with the family and get given a towelling

parts.note: forty winks is a short sleep, a nap
kin are one's family

explanation.surface: Snoozing among relatives and then receiving a thrashing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A towelling' looks like a beating, but here it is a cloth for wiping, as a table napkin is.
explanation.definitionFit: A table napkin is a small cloth for wiping the lips and fingers.

clue.text: Disregard a Jewish festival

definitions.meaning: to ... something is to ignore it
the spring feast commemorating the Exodus from Egypt

explanation.definitionFit: To ignore or skip something, and also the Hebrew spring feast of the Exodus.

clue.text: Where two boxers may take it squarely on the jaw? Cheers!

definitions.text: Where two boxers may take it squarely on the jaw?
definitions.meaning: two boxers face to face meet jaw to jaw
an old-fashioned toast when raising a glass

explanation.definitionFit: A jokey picture of fighters jaw to jaw, and a dated toast for drinking someone's health.

clue.text: Where an icy reception would await a native of Gdansk

definitions.text: Where an icy reception would await a native of Gdansk

parts.words: Where an icy reception would await a native of Gdansk
parts.note: a person from Poland is a Pole; one from the northern port fits the name of the frozen top of the world

explanation.definitionFit: The Arctic's northernmost point is a freezing spot, and a Gdansk native is a northern Pole.

clue.text: They hit the economy by downing tools

definitions.text: They hit the economy by downing tools

parts.words: They hit the economy by downing tools
parts.note: workers who down tools in protest harm the economy; those who hit things share the name

explanation.definitionFit: Workers on industrial action stop work, and anyone who hits things is also so called.

clue.text: Group in an exclusive social class has got things taped

indicators.note: in places the group inside the social class

parts.note: a caste is a rigid hereditary social class
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A clique within a snobbish elite has everything under control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Has got things taped' looks like being in control, but means holding recordings on tape.
explanation.definitionFit: An audio tape cartridge holds recorded sound.

clue.text: Warm coverings provided by a couple firms on Sunday

indicators.note: a couple means two, so the abbreviation is written twice

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
taken as written

explanation.surface: Two companies supply snug wraps at the weekend.
explanation.definitionFit: Silky cases spun by larvae enclose and protect them, like a snug blanket.

clue.text: Tick given to work of good quality

definitions.meaning: tick is slang for ..., as in buying on tick

definitions.text: given to work of good quality
definitions.meaning: a grade awarded to a good exam or piece of work

explanation.definitionFit: Deferred payment, as in buying on tick, and also a good grade awarded in an exam.

clue.text: Unreservedly the friend of little children

parts.note: a tot is a small child
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone who is wholeheartedly a pal to small kids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The friend of little children' is read as a tot's ally, so the child comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Completely, without any holding back, is unreservedly.

clue.text: How mince is cooked in China town?

definitions.text: How mince is cooked in China town?

indicators.note: cooking the letters stirs them into a new order

explanation.surface: A question about how minced meat is prepared in a Chinese district.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese dish of fried noodles is the sort of meal minced meat might go into in Chinatown.

clue.text: Bohemian girl goes round a Transatlantic resort

indicators.note: going round means surrounding the next piece

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's opera La Bohème

explanation.surface: A girl from the bohemian world travels round a resort across the Atlantic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Florida city is a beach holiday destination across the ocean from Britain.

clue.text: Shall a sound holiday home be constructed?

indicators.note: sound tells us the words are to be heard rather than read

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: A question of whether a holiday house should be built.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden mountain cabin is a typical vacation lodging.

clue.text: Learning about one type of French wine

indicators.note: about means surrounding the next piece

parts.note: lore is learning, traditional knowledge
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Studying one variety of wine from France.
explanation.definitionFit: Wines from the valley of France's longest river are named after it.

clue.text: Tailpiece written by North European

parts.note: a fin is the tail part of a plane or fish
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: An epilogue composed by a Scandinavian author.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Finland is a northern European.

clue.text: Appeal to the little woman with a last letter

parts.note: O is the exclamation used to address or invoke someone
Meg is one of the four sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: Pleading with one's wife and sending a final note.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek alphabet ends with this character.

clue.text: It must express the paper's policy in detail, or I get confused

definitions.text: It must express the paper's policy

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A newspaper's line must be set out precisely, or a writer is muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: A leading article states a newspaper's opinion on an issue.

clue.text: Popular letter subscription, but not for genuine reasons

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
a sign-off written at the foot of a letter

explanation.surface: A well-liked sign-off on a letter, used without real feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Subscription' is used in its old sense of a signature written beneath a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting without real feeling or honesty is acting falsely.
